# Canadian Grocer

> Canadian Grocer is the audited national publication delivering comprehensive grocery industry news, market research, and insights across Canada's retail and food manufacturing sectors.

Canadian Grocer covers the full spectrum of grocery retail and food production in Canada, including news on major retailers (Loblaw, Sobeys, Farm Boy), product categories from beverages to plant-based foods, and industry events recognizing leadership and innovation. The publication serves as a primary resource for understanding supply chain dynamics, regulatory changes, and emerging trends in Canadian grocery.

## Key Topics

- Grocery retail
- Food safety
- Supply chain
- Product launches
- Market trends
- Sustainability
- Canadian agriculture
- Food manufacturing
- Industry news
- Retail expansion
- Loblaw
- Sobeys
- Plant-based foods
- Pricing inflation
- Industry recognition

## News & Industry Coverage

- [Homepage](https://canadiangrocer.com): Homepage for Canadian Grocer, the audited national grocery publication.
- [News](https://canadiangrocer.com/news): News hub covering grocery industry updates, supply chain, and regulatory topics.

## Product Categories

- [Beverages](https://canadiangrocer.com/beverages): Beverages category covering Coca-Cola, Keurig, energy drinks, and market trends.
- [Dairy/Deli/Bakery](https://canadiangrocer.com/dairydelibakery): Dairy, deli, and bakery category featuring supply management and Canadian agriculture.
- [Health & Wellness](https://canadiangrocer.com/health-wellness): Health & wellness trends, food additives, nutrition, and clean snacks coverage.
- [Meat & Seafood](https://canadiangrocer.com/meat-seafood): Meat and seafood industry news, food safety, recalls, and pricing from Loblaw.
- [Plant-based](https://canadiangrocer.com/plant-based): Plant-based foods, dairy alternatives, and meat alternatives industry coverage.
- [Produce](https://canadiangrocer.com/produce): Produce industry news covering food safety, organic trends, and pricing inflation.
- [Non-food](https://canadiangrocer.com/non-food): Non-food products category covering tissue, paper goods, and retail expansion.

## Retail & Market Updates

- [New on Shelf](https://canadiangrocer.com/products): New product launches and shelf displays across food, beverages, and personal care.
- [New Stores](https://canadiangrocer.com/new-stores): Store openings and renovations from retailers like Farm Boy, Sobeys, and Calgary Co-op.

## Events & Awards

- [Events/Awards Hub](https://canadiangrocer.com/eventsawards): Events and awards hub featuring Generation Next, Star Women, and Impact Awards.
- [GroceryTech Canada 2026](https://events.canadiangrocer.com/GroceryTech2026Canada): GroceryTech Canada 2026 tech summit in Toronto featuring AI and digital commerce.
- [Impact Awards](https://events.canadiangrocer.com/2026): Impact Awards recognizing sustainability, diversity, and community initiatives.
- [2025 Star Women in Grocery Award Winners](https://canadiangrocer.com/2025-star-women-grocery-award-winners): 2025 Star Women in Grocery Award winners and industry leadership recognition.
